API reference

This reference is generated from the docstrings in the source code. Each page starts with a summary table, followed by the full documentation of every class and function. Use the [source] links to read the implementation.

For the HTTP endpoints, see REST API endpoints.

Data and business logic

news.models

Database models for the Django News Application.

news.services

Business services for article approval and notifications.

news.signals

Signal handlers that keep each user's permission group in sync with role.

Web interface

news.forms

Validated HTML forms for the news application.

news.views

HTML views and role-based workflows for the news application.

news.urls

URL routes for the HTML pages of the news app.

news.admin

Django admin site registrations for the news models.

REST API

news.api.serializers

Serializers for converting application models to API representations.

news.api.permissions

Role-based permission classes for the REST API.

news.api.views

REST API endpoints for news content and subscriptions.

news.api_urls

URL routes for the token-authenticated REST API (mounted at /api/).

Project and app configuration

news.apps

Django application configuration for the news app.

news.management.commands.seed_demo

The seed_demo management command, which creates local demo data.

news_application.settings

Django settings for the news application.
